instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In an indoor studio with a plain dusty pink background, two friends lean close. On the left, the curly-haired woman in a white button-down shirt (R1) tilts her head and smiles warmly at the camera. Behind her on the right, the straight-haired woman in a denim jacket (R2) stands laughing with closed eyes, resting her right hand on the curly-haired woman's shoulder. Soft, warm studio lighting illuminates the scene, casting a gentle glow over the pastel pink setting.
